params.body:
`hand.mjs policy sign` signs the head of a policy version, which names the body by hash, so the YubiKey signs a few hundred bytes whatever the grants weigh.

Until now the token signed the whole JCS payload, and the YubiKey refuses anything above about a kilobyte (CKR_DATA_LEN_RANGE); the first real widening was 6.6 KB. The gateway (control, policy-digest) reads a three-part token `head.body.signature`.

- `policyToken` makes the digest form; `policyTokenWhole` keeps the earlier form.
- `signPolicy` asks the gateway which forms it reads (`formats` on `/v1/agents`) and signs in the digest form only when it is listed; a gateway that does not answer gets nothing signed, since a version in the wrong form would block the chain.
- The token's error names the size when it refuses input over a kilobyte.
- README updated.

`node --test lib/policy.test.mjs`: 7 pass (head, body and hash, the head staying under 400 bytes for 200 repositories, the old form for an older gateway). One unrelated test in `lib/stocklist-read.test.mjs` fails on main as well.
